data.narrative:
Heaviside is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Phillip Walker that has raised $28M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 11 companies operating in the same sector and at the same or adjacent stage, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

The Stage-Progression method was deemed inapplicable due to an unreliable base valuation exceeding 20x total capital raised. Instead, the Peer-Median approach anchors the analysis. The median valuation across the 11-company comparable set is $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). Representative peers at Series B include Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

The triangulated valuation range is $850M to $1.1B, with a median of $1.0B. This reflects Heaviside's stage positioning within a cohort of frontier-defense companies. Key uncertainties include relative product maturity versus Series B comparables—which likely command higher valuations—and differentiation in addressable market capture, neither of which the available data permits quantification. The reliance on a single applicable method underscores the importance of additional customer-traction or revenue metrics in narrowing range confidence.
